commonPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: ONE compact teaching vignette for printed vegetable Sowing & Planting instructions, legible at 36–48 mm width. Image 1 is Concept 2 STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; ignore all its text, measurements, mature crops and page layout. Image 2 is the approved CARROT ART STYLE ANCHOR: match its warm chocolate fine ink, pale sandy-tan soil stipple, soft muted watercolour, natural skin tone and economical botanical detail. Generate a NEW crop action, NOT another carrot. Wide 2:1 canvas, target 1536x768. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, no paper, no background rectangle. One scene, meaningful artwork centred within 7% safe margins. Restrained greens, light soil, generous blank space. No text, numbers, arrows, badges, border, watermark, dimension marks or mature crop portrait. Anatomy and physical planting action must be coherent; roots connected to stems. All exact dimensions will be added separately from live source. Do not over-enlarge hands or tiny seeds.
